One of the best meals of our 3 week trip
Aug 2026 • Family
When we look back at the food on our 3 week holiday - encompassing HK and various places in Vietnam - Nina’s cafe warrants a very high mention.

Venue is down an alley and properly unassuming but once inside all is very cute. The very energetic front of house lady made sure our orders were correct and we then enjoyed an absolutely first class meal. Chicken with caramel was insanely good, as was the chicken rice which came with a beautifully cooked leg of chicken. Spectacular.

My wife had been sceptical but even she admitted this was a great meal which was also ludicrously good value.

Hidden gem !
Aug 2026 • Family
We had lunch at Nina’s cafe, we selected it based on the reviews and we were not disappointed. The food was delicious, we especially enjoyed Nina’s special, the beef was well cooked and the flavours worked so well together. Definitely recommend this and the rice cakes.

We were served by Moon, who provided excellent customer service and her English was impeccable. She also taught us the correct way to eat some of the traditional dishes (this being our first time in Vietnam).

If in Hue, definitely recommend this hidden gem.
